description:
This image is a screenshot of the CLC+ (next-generation land cover/land use) Core data catalogue web interface, showing an "Extraction view" for selecting and reviewing "Input Classes" alongside a geographic map.

The left-hand panel displays metadata for the current selection:
- Reference Year: 2018
- Time Range of Extracted Data: 01.12.2018 - 31.12.2018
- INSPIRE (Infrastructure for Spatial Information in the European Community) Themes: LU Land use, LC Land cover
- Created By: User Admin/Support CLC+ Core
- Organisation/s: European Environment Agency (EEA)
- Contact Person: -
- Link to Document/s: -
- Description: -
- Additional Documents section with a "Drag and Drop OR" prompt.

The central panel shows a list of "Input Classes" in a tabular format, with column headers: "Rank", "Class Code", "Name", "Ingestion", "Eagle Elements", "100% Eagle compliant", "Colour", and "Show in Map".
Above this table, an open dropdown menu under "Ingestion", "Class", and "Coverage" shows potential selections:
- "HRL - Forest Type (FTY) 2018" with "Broadleaved forest" (66%)
- "HRL - Small Woody Features (SWF) 2015" with "Additional woody features" (50%)
- "HRL - Small Woody" with "Small woody"

The visible "Input Classes" are:
1. Rank: 1., Class Code: 3, Name: "Additional wood...", Ingestion: "HRL - Small Woo...", Eagle Elements: "Woody Vegetation +3", 100% Eagle compliant: checked, Colour: yellow, Show in Map: toggle off.
2. Rank: 2., Class Code: 1, Name: "Small woody fea...", Ingestion: "HRL - Small Woo...", Eagle Elements: "Woody Veget... +3", 100% Eagle compliant: checked, Colour: green, Show in Map: toggle off.
3. Rank: 3., Class Code: 1, Name: "Broadleaved for...", Ingestion: "HRL - Forest Typ...", Eagle Elements: A tooltip is open displaying "4 elements", specifically "Woody Vegetation (5)", "Mosaic (Clearly Distinct Patches) (5)", "Hedge Rows (1)", "Rows of Trees (1)". The "100% Eagle compliant" is checked, Colour: dark green, Show in Map: toggle on.
4. Rank: 4., Class Code: 2, Name: "Coniferous forest", Ingestion: [unreadable], Eagle Elements: [unreadable], 100% Eagle compliant: checked, Colour: dark green, Show in Map: toggle off.

The right-hand panel displays a geographic map with a scale bar indicating "1 km" and "1 mi". The map shows an area with visible labels "Uithuizen", "Middelstum", "Roodeschool", "Oostende", "Provincialeweg", and "Usquert". The map attribution is "Leaflet | © Core03 Mosaic, © OpenStreetMap contributors".

The browser address bar shows the URL: `https://clcplus-core.land.copernicus.eu/datacatalogue/extraction/...`. The bottom-right corner of the screenshot displays the date "16.12.2023" and time "21:34".
